question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term is related to third term.

AF14 : FO28 :: RH13 : WQ27 :: LC26 : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• **First letter ⇒ **(5) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• **Second letter **⇒ (9) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• **Last number **⇒ (14) is added to the given number.

So,

 
• AF14 : FO28

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9102094d686a0d62a7c5359b5b0c19521ac087f47d5079bb1e8bea6a99714cf4.png] 

​And,

 
• RH13 : WQ27

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccd0bfb3ad77717e3fb73c2ff7a5e27ad65a02ff1f870c7c9b2e228185870079.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• LC26 : ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b3062a2c3ed3cb75cda674e4ff3ecc5036ed7e381d9a3902f84433a8904bc80.png] 

​Hence, "QL40" is the correct answer.
